title: EOG information beyond EEG and sleep timing

titles: Sleep-EDF Expanded: Sleep Cassette development scope

scientific_question: Under matched procedures and complete person/epoch support, does adding horizontal EOG to EEG plus clock improve held-person sleep-stage predictions, especially REM recall?
primary_outputs: Expert hypnogram stage labels for both observation arms and the deterministic paired differences from their independently committed prediction panels. The sign of the EOG contribution is unknown before evaluation and may be zero or negative.

data_manifest.declared_subset: 153 Sleep Cassette recording nights from 78 participants, corroborated by the official MNE age_records.csv mapping; exclude the 44 Sleep Telemetry recordings from this first scope.

example_labels.validation: Downloaded the 4,620-byte annotation file only; SHA256 matches publisher and EDF+ labels/onsets/durations are present.

recording_contract.neural: Representative EDF header: EEG Fpz-Cz and EEG Pz-Oz at 100 Hz; horizontal EOG 100 Hz. Respiration, submental EMG, temperature and Event marker are 1 Hz in this file; channel rates must be read per asset.
recording_contract.labels: Actual EDF+ annotation file contains Sleep stage W,1,2,3,4,R,? with onset/duration. Merge 3+4 to N3 for a five-class task; mask unscored/movement intervals evaluator-side under an explicit policy.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Signal and annotation header start date/time agree (24 April 1989,16:13:00); EDF+ onset/duration labels align to the signal clock. First wake annotation spans 0–30,630 seconds; fixed 30-second epochs must use the recording clock.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 78 Sleep Cassette people, multiple recording nights per person; MNE age_records.csv provides participant/night/asset mapping. Group all nights of one person in a split.
recording_contract.evidence: Actual 2,048-byte EDF header and complete 4,620-byte hypnogram inspected; no EEG sample payload downloaded.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Historical finite arms:12 EEG engineered features +3 clock features versus those15 plus6 horizontal-EOG features; same six training people and same two held-development people.
Proposed full153 successor uses raw C/EC/OC/EOC views under the shared NEURAL007 whole-clock contract; it is not an adopted completed replacement for the finite engineered-feature task.
forbidden_inputs: EOG or full-modality pretrained outputs in the EEG-only arm; shared YASA caches therefore cannot be blindly mounted.
Development stage labels, private masks, answer-bearing source annotations, or feedback before both full panels are committed.
Different training rows, hidden label-based crops or selectively dropped REM-poor people across arms.

primary.name: paired_equal_person_macro_F1_difference_EEG_EOG_clock_minus_EEG_clock
primary.aggregation: Compute each person’s fixed-five-class macro-F1 in each complete arm, subtract EEG+clock from EEG+EOG+clock, then average people equally; retain both absolute arms.
primary.rationale: The scientific question is an incremental contrast with either sign valid, not a scalar maximization game. Report full-arm absolute quality to expose deliberately weak baselines.

secondary: Equal-person REM-recall difference with explicit support; aggregate is null if any required person lacks true REM, while the primary includes everyone.
Both arms’ per-person confusion matrices, fixed-stage F1 and recall, and matched comparator contrasts.
Numeric claim agreement for the exact registered aggregates/people, explicitly separate from scientific reasoning.
Probability calibration needs actual probabilities and a bound companion; confusion matrices alone are insufficient.

comparators.name: matched RF EEG+clock / EEG+EOG+clock
comparators.inputs: Same feature rows, labels, tuning policy and budget; only horizontal-EOG features added.
comparators.procedure: Historical fixed RF comparator pair, to be rebound and authenticated before replay. Method differences require review.

comparators.name: clock-only / EEG-without-clock / EOG+clock / training-majority
comparators.inputs: Prespecified nested signal and nuisance inputs.
comparators.procedure: Historical comparator set; do not select a favorable subset after scoring.

comparators.name: fixed within-person EOG displacement
comparators.inputs: Same model state with prespecified displaced query EOG.
comparators.procedure: Alignment sensitivity diagnostic only; not a null distribution or causal intervention.

evaluation.uncertainty: Finite panel: two descriptive paired person values, no population interval/p-value. Full153 source offers person/fold sensitivity with shared-training dependence retained; any future population inference requires an explicit validated plan.
evaluation.failure_policy: Both exact full-clock probability panels must validate before private label access. Missing/duplicated/invalid epochs or inconsistent claim types are refused; undefined REM is null with full denominator, never silently reduced to supported people.

resources.basis: Planning estimate only; reuse author processed inputs first. Training/runtime/storage not measured for this task.

source_storage_evidence.bounded_intake_plan: Two participant nights for schema/loader checks, then a person-grouped development panel; do not select nights or people based on reference performance.
source_storage_evidence.compute_estimate: CPU-oriented bandpower plus random forest; runtime/RAM not measured, and entire archive need not be loaded simultaneously.

Freeze source versions, selection/exclusion, fitting and case-adaptive access, resource budget, split and primary estimator before outcomes.

Implement evaluator and negative tests for IDs, malformed/constant outputs, leakage, missingness and relevant null controls.
Independently reproduce scoring and reference; determine scientific admission criteria before agent outcomes. Public data remain development.
